hero.lede: I've spent 4 years building enterprise products with Angular. I like modernizing large codebases, making slow apps fast, and laying foundations teams can confidently build on.

work.title: Selected work
work.note: Work with measurable outcomes. Product details of enterprise projects are kept general.

cases.title: Speeding up and modernizing an enterprise monitoring platform
cases.body: A large Angular SPA for data-center monitoring, localized in four languages. I moved eight modules to route-level lazy loading, deferred heavy scripts to first use, and rewrote 50+ pages onto Signals, typed reactive forms and an SDK I generated from the OpenAPI spec.

cases.title: Session lifecycle and a single state layer
cases.body: Auto-login, idle timeout with warning, silent token refresh, cross-tab sync and a circuit breaker for backend outages across six services. I moved state kept in three places into one layer and removed full-page reloads.

cases.title: Energy management and KPI modules
cases.body: Designed end to end on the frontend: energy nodes, cost records, per-outlet PDU consumption, a reporting set of seven chart and table types, and KPI threshold management.

cases.title: Angular component library
cases.body: 50+ Signals-based components with their own palette, light/dark theming, WCAG contrast checks and a separate demo app. Going public soon.

cases.title: Company website and appointment system
cases.body: A bilingual, mobile-first PWA for a construction company in Isparta. Request forms turn into WhatsApp messages; appointment requests are approved from an admin panel.
